notes.title: Game Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with loading levels for the first time
- Changed how leaderboards are displayed so your times are always shown
- Removed and prevented zero-second times from appearing on the leaderboards

notes.title: Leaderboard Upload FIxes
notes.content: FIxed some issues with uploading times properly to leaderboards

notes.title: Leaderboard Fixes
notes.content: Small patch to fix display issues with leaderboards

notes.title: Actually Fixed Block Duplication Bug
notes.content: This update should actually fix the block duplication bug that the previous update claimed to fix.

notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.content:
- Added Steam leaderboard support
Old and new leaderboard scores will be uploaded as you play, and are displayed at each level end
Scores may take some time to upload

- Fixed a bug that allowed level objects to duplicate infinitely
